what: Steel Dynamics melts recycled scrap in electric arc furnaces to make steel, and also fabricates it into finished products such as steel joists and decking for buildings. It is building a large aluminium rolling mill.
customers: Construction contractors, carmakers, equipment manufacturers, appliance makers and steel service centres.
moat: Low-cost electric arc furnaces, its own scrap supply, and a fabrication business that uses its own steel and earns a better margin than selling raw coils.
risks: Steel prices are cyclical and drive earnings
Revenue fell about 7% a year over three years
The aluminium mill is a large project outside its traditional business
Imports and tariff policy change competitive conditions quickly
opportunities: Tariffs on imported steel and aluminium support domestic prices
Data centre and manufacturing construction raises demand for its fabricated products
watch: Steel shipments, fabrication backlog, and the aluminium mill ramp.
